question: Should beta3 publish the three operator-write wake mutation RPCs before the PR5 internal delivery handoff is proven, or should this slice remain inspection-only until the full durable stack is reviewed together?
rationale: Tests can verify implementation mechanics, but they cannot decide when acknowledge, supersede, and mark become supported public operator contracts with durable state and delivery consequences.

options.title: Land inspection first
options.body: Publish the five read-only RPCs now and defer wake mutations until PR5 proves the complete delivery and recovery lifecycle.

options.title: Review the full stack together
options.body: Keep this PR open and approve the read/write API only with the cumulative PR5 implementation and upgrade proof.

options.title: Accept beta writes now
options.body: Approve the three mutation RPCs as supported beta contracts now and explicitly own their compatibility and rollback semantics.

recommendation.title: Land inspection first
recommendation.body: Publish the five read-only RPCs now and defer wake mutations until PR5 proves the complete delivery and recovery lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses several core ownership boundaries and establishes a new public persisted-state control contract.
